prompt_payload.task: Design a diverse library of scientific transfer proposals for finite-pool search. The proposals must be auditable and grounded in the supplied public schema.

target.title: MoleculeNet Lipophilicity replay
target.boundary: Field values and counts are public; target outcomes are not included.

source_transfer_evidence.boundary: Only source identity, objective, and public source-target field alignment are provided. Source outcomes, effects, support counts, and value priors are withheld.

executor.semantic_model: The hypothesis compiler turns each accepted mechanism hypothesis into one binary rule with a fixed signed weight; target outcomes only fit the online surrogate.
executor.anchor: A rank blend of target-only GP-UCB and GP-EI.
executor.fusion: semantic_mass_start/end controls the rank mass assigned to the semantic surrogate; the remaining mass stays on the target-only anchor.
executor.selection: No target calibration is used in the zero-shot protocol. Every proposal is frozen before the target replay and is reported without target-based selection.

design_requirements: Use only exact field/value pairs in public_semantic_fields.

Each conditions object must map a real catalog field name directly to one exact catalog value, for example {"dominant_family": "oxide"}. Never use literal placeholder keys such as exact_field, field_name, field, or value.
Give every skill a distinct, descriptive scientific skill_id. Never copy schema placeholders such as short_unique_name or add numeric suffixes to a placeholder.
Use two-condition interactions only when scientifically meaningful.
Include at least one skill grounded only in the supplied source-target field alignment; do not imply that source outcome effects were observed.
Include at least one domain-knowledge proposal.
Include a counter-hypothesis proposal that reverses or downweights an uncertain source relation.
Prefer mechanistic, chemically or physically interpretable rules over arbitrary coverage rules.
Do not claim access to target outcomes and do not output candidate identifiers.

hypotheses.mechanism: why the source evidence or domain knowledge should transfer
failure_conditions: when the hypothesis should be rejected

hypotheses.claim: A higher count of aromatic structures increases normalized lipophilicity.
hypotheses.mechanism: Aromatic structures enhance electron delocalization, which can improve lipophilicity.
failure_conditions: when the aromatic structures do not contribute to lipophilicity

hypotheses.claim: Halogen substitution in molecules increases normalized lipophilicity.
hypotheses.mechanism: Halogens can enhance lipophilicity due to their electronegative nature, affecting molecular interactions.
failure_conditions: when halogen substitution leads to steric hindrance

hypotheses.claim: Increased branching in molecular structure decreases normalized lipophilicity.
hypotheses.mechanism: Branching can create steric hindrance, reducing the ability of a molecule to interact favorably with lipophilic environments.
failure_conditions: when branching does not affect lipophilicity

hypotheses.claim: A lower count of heteroatoms may lead to higher normalized lipophilicity.
hypotheses.mechanism: Fewer heteroatoms can reduce polarity, potentially increasing lipophilicity.
failure_conditions: when the presence of heteroatoms is essential for lipophilicity

hypotheses.claim: Molecules with a higher count of ring structures exhibit increased normalized lipophilicity.
hypotheses.mechanism: Ring structures can stabilize the molecule and enhance its interaction with lipophilic environments.
failure_conditions: when ring structures introduce unfavorable interactions
